    // Universal Fail-Safe Orbit Controls
    function setupUniversalOrbitControls(camera, domElement, targetVec = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.0, 0)) {
      if (typeof THREE.OrbitControls === 'function') {
        try {
          const ctrl = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, domElement);
          ctrl.enableDamping = true;
          ctrl.dampingFactor = 0.05;
          ctrl.target.copy(targetVec);
          return ctrl;
        } catch (e1) {}
      }
      return { update: () => {}, dispose: () => {} };
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 3. MAIN REACT APP COMPONENT
    // =========================================================================
    function SBC350App() {
      const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('block3d'); // 'block3d' | 'trans' | 'dyno' | 'schematics' | 'shop'
      const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState('realistic'); // 'realistic' | 'ghost' | 'cutaway'
      
      // CUTAWAY VIEW SYSTEM
      const [cutawayMode, setCutawayMode] = useState('rightBank'); // 'none' | 'rightBank' | 'centerLongitudinal' | 'valvetrain'
      const [explodedAmount, setExplodedAmount] = useState(0);
      const [rpm, setRpm] = useState(850);
      const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);
      const [selectedPart, setSelectedPart] = useState(null);

      // Transmission 3D View State
      const [selectedTrans, setSelectedTrans] = useState('th350');
      const [stallSpeed, setStallSpeed] = useState(2400);
      const [transExploded, setTransExploded] = useState(0);
      const [transRunning, setTransRunning] = useState(false);

      // Header Height Measurement Ref
      const headerRef = useRef(null);
      const [headerHeight, setHeaderHeight] = useState(140);

      useEffect(() => {
        if (headerRef.current) {
          setHeaderHeight(headerRef.current.offsetHeight || 140);
        }
      }, []);

      const [currentEngineId, setCurrentEngineId] = useState('sbc_350_ray');
      const [selectedIntakeId, setSelectedIntakeId] = useState('sbc_dual_rpm');
      const [camProfile, setCamProfile] = useState('street');

      const activeEngine = ENGINE_DATABASE[currentEngineId] || ENGINE_DATABASE.sbc_350_ray;
      const currentTrans = TRANSMISSIONS_DB[selectedTrans] || TRANSMISSIONS_DB.th350;
      const activeIntake = activeEngine.intakes?.find(i => i.id === selectedIntakeId) || activeEngine.intakes?.[0];

      // Mutable Refs for Real-Time 60fps Loop
      const isRunningRef = useRef(false);
      const rpmRef = useRef(850);
      const explodedAmountRef = useRef(0);
      const transExplodedRef = useRef(0);
      const transRunningRef = useRef(false);

      useEffect(() => { isRunningRef.current = isRunning; }, [isRunning]);
      useEffect(() => { rpmRef.current = rpm; }, [rpm]);
      useEffect(() => { explodedAmountRef.current = explodedAmount; }, [explodedAmount]);
      useEffect(() => { transExplodedRef.current = transExploded; }, [transExploded]);
      useEffect(() => { transRunningRef.current = transRunning; }, [transRunning]);

      const canvasContainerRef = useRef(null);
      const transCanvasContainerRef = useRef(null);

      // Helper to generate 6-sided hex bolt head
      const createHexBoltMesh = (radius, length, mat) => {
        const boltGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const hexHead = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius * 1.5, radius * 1.5, radius * 0.9, 6), mat);
        const washer = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius * 1.8, radius * 1.8, radius * 0.2, 16), mat);
        washer.position.y = -radius * 0.45;
        const shank = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, length, 12), mat);
        shank.position.y = -length / 2 - radius * 0.45;
        boltGroup.add(hexHead);
        boltGroup.add(washer);
        boltGroup.add(shank);
        return boltGroup;
      };

      // --- ENGINE 3D INITIALIZATION WITH REALISTIC CUTAWAY DETAIL ---
      useEffect(() => {
        if (activeTab !== 'block3d') return;
        const container = canvasContainerRef.current;
        if (!container) return;

        const winW = window.innerWidth || 800;
        const winH = window.innerHeight || 600;
        const safeH = Math.max(480, winH - (headerRef.current?.offsetHeight || 140));

        const initialW = Math.max(container.clientWidth || winW, 320);
        const initialH = Math.max(container.clientHeight || safeH, 300);

        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(viewMode === 'technical' ? 0x07111a : 0x14181c);

        let renderer;
        try {
          renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false, powerPreference: 'default' });
        } catch (e1) {
          renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: false });
        }
        renderer.localClippingEnabled = true;
        renderer.setSize(initialW, initialH);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
        container.innerHTML = '';
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.85));
        const dirLight1 = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        dirLight1.position.set(20, 25, 20);
        scene.add(dirLight1);
        const dirLight2 = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x90b0ff, 0.6);
        dirLight2.position.set(-20, 15, -20);
        scene.add(dirLight2);

        const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(30, 30, 0x00f0ff, 0x223344);
        gridHelper.position.y = -5.5;
        scene.add(gridHelper);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, initialW / initialH, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(18, 14, 22);
        camera.lookAt(0, 1.0, 0);

        const controls = setupUniversalOrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement, new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.0, 0));

        // Cutaway Slicing Planes
        let activeClippingPlanes = [];
        if (cutawayMode === 'rightBank') {
          activeClippingPlanes = [new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(-1, -0.6, 0).normalize(), 0.8)];
        } else if (cutawayMode === 'centerLongitudinal') {
          activeClippingPlanes = [new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), 0.2)];
        } else if (cutawayMode === 'valvetrain') {
          activeClippingPlanes = [new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0), 3.5)];
        }

        const isGhost = viewMode === 'ghost';
        const isTech = viewMode === 'technical';

        // Physically-Based Machine Shop Materials
        const materials = {
          blockCasting: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            color: isTech ? 0x00f0ff : activeEngine.color,
            roughness: 0.75, // Sand-cast texture
            metalness: 0.18,
            wireframe: isTech,
            transparent: isGhost,
            opacity: isGhost ? 0.35 : 1.0,
            clippingPlanes: activeClippingPlanes,
            clipShadows: true
          }),
          headCasting: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            color: isTech ? 0x66ccff : 0xc4cbd2,
            roughness: 0.4,
            metalness: 0.65,
            wireframe: isTech,
            transparent: isGhost,
            opacity: isGhost ? 0.35 : 1.0,
            clippingPlanes: activeClippingPlanes,
            clipShadows: true
          }),
          machinedDeck: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd8dee4, roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.85 }),
          crankJournals: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe2e8f0, roughness: 0.1, metalness: 0.95 }),
          forgedRods: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x64748b, roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.8 }),
          pistonAlloy: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd8dee4, roughness: 0.22, metalness: 0.78 }),
          pistonRings: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1e293b, roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.95 }),
          wristPin: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf8fafc, roughness: 0.08, metalness: 0.98 }),
          fasteners: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x334155, roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.9 }), // Black Oxide ARP
          camshaft: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x475569, roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.85 }),
          rollerLifters: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x94a3b8, roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.9 }),
          rockerArms: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0284c7, roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.8 }), // Anodized Blue Billet
          valves: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf1f5f9, roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.9 }),
          valveSprings: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe5a823, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.85 }),
          chrome: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.08, metalness: 0.98 }),
          sleeveBore: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x475569, roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.85, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
        };

        const engineGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const parts = {};

        const boreRadius = (activeEngine.bore / 4.0) * 1.15;
        const crankRadius = (activeEngine.stroke / 3.48) * (3.480 * 0.35);
        const rodLength = (activeEngine.rodLength / 5.70) * (5.700 * 0.35);

        // 1. ENGINE BLOCK CASTING WITH MACHINED DECKS & FASTENERS
        const blockGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const crankcase = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(6.4, 3.8, 12), materials.blockCasting);
        crankcase.position.y = -0.5;
        blockGroup.add(crankcase);

        // 4-Bolt Splayed Main Caps underneath with hex bolts
        for (let m = 0; m < 5; m++) {
          const capZ = -5.0 + m * 2.5;
          const mainCap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.6, 1.4, 1.2), materials.machinedDeck);
          mainCap.position.set(0, -2.1, capZ);
          blockGroup.add(mainCap);

          // 4 Hex main cap bolts
          [-1.2, 1.2].forEach((xOff) => {
            const bolt = createHexBoltMesh(0.18, 1.5, materials.fasteners);
            bolt.position.set(xOff, -2.8, capZ);
            bolt.rotation.x = Math.PI;
            blockGroup.add(bolt);
          });
        }

        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          const bankGroup = new THREE.Group();
          bankGroup.position.set(side * 2.1, 1.2, side === 1 ? -0.2 : 0.2);
          bankGroup.rotation.z = side * (-Math.PI / 4);

          const deck = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4.4, 2.8, 11.8), materials.blockCasting);
          bankGroup.add(deck);

          // Cylinder Sleeves
          for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const sleeve = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(boreRadius + 0.08, boreRadius + 0.08, 3.0, 24, 1, true), materials.sleeveBore);
            sleeve.position.set(0, 0, -4.5 + i * 3.0);
            bankGroup.add(sleeve);
          }
          blockGroup.add(bankGroup);
        });
        engineGroup.add(blockGroup);
        parts.block = blockGroup;

        // 2. CRANKSHAFT WITH MIRROR-POLISHED JOURNALS & BALANCED COUNTERWEIGHTS
        const crankGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const mainSnout = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.7, 0.7, 13.5, 20), materials.crankJournals);
        mainSnout.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        mainSnout.position.y = -1.0;
        crankGroup.add(mainSnout);

        // Counterweights with drill-balance holes
        for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
          const cwMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.8, 1.8, 0.5, 16, 1, false, 0, Math.PI), materials.machinedDeck);
          cwMesh.rotation.z = (j % 2 === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI);
          cwMesh.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
          cwMesh.position.set(0, -1.0, -5.2 + j * 2.6);

          // Drill-lightening balance hole
          const drillHole = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.35, 0.6, 12), materials.fasteners);
          drillHole.position.set(0.9, -0.6, 0);
          cwMesh.add(drillHole);

          crankGroup.add(cwMesh);
        }
        engineGroup.add(crankGroup);
        parts.crank = crankGroup;

        // 3. CAMSHAFT & 16 LIFTERS, PUSHRODS, ROCKERS & VALVES
        const camGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const camCore = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.4, 0.4, 12.0, 16), materials.camshaft);
        camCore.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        camCore.position.set(0, 1.1, 0);
        camGroup.add(camCore);

        const valvetrainNodes = [];
        for (let c = 0; c < 16; c++) {
          const zPos = -5.0 + c * 0.65;
          const lobe = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.55, 0.42, 0.35, 12), materials.camshaft);
          lobe.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
          lobe.rotation.z = (c * Math.PI) / 4;
          lobe.position.set(0, 1.1, zPos);
          camGroup.add(lobe);

          const lSide = c % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
          const lifter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.25, 0.25, 0.9, 12), materials.rollerLifters);
          lifter.position.set(lSide * 0.6, 1.8, zPos);
          camGroup.add(lifter);

          const pushrod = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.08, 0.08, 2.8, 8), materials.crankJournals);
          pushrod.position.set(lSide * 1.4, 3.1, zPos);
          pushrod.rotation.z = -lSide * 0.28;
          camGroup.add(pushrod);

          const rocker = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, 0.35, 0.9), materials.rockerArms);
          rocker.position.set(lSide * 2.2, 4.4, zPos);
          camGroup.add(rocker);

          const spring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.35, 1.2, 12), materials.valveSprings);
          spring.position.set(lSide * 2.5, 3.8, zPos);
          camGroup.add(spring);

          const valve = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.12, 0.55, 2.2, 12), materials.valves);
          valve.position.set(lSide * 2.5, 3.0, zPos);
          camGroup.add(valve);

          valvetrainNodes.push({ lifter, valve, rocker, baseY: 1.8, offset: c * 0.4 });
        }
        engineGroup.add(camGroup);
        parts.cam = camGroup;

        // 4. FORGED 5.700" H-BEAM RODS, FLAT-TOP PISTONS & RING PACKS
        const rotatingGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const pistonNodes = [];

        for (let p = 0; p < 8; p++) {
          const isRight = p % 2 === 0;
          const bankSign = isRight ? 1 : -1;
          const cylIndex = Math.floor(p / 2);

          const pGroup = new THREE.Group();
          pGroup.position.set(bankSign * 1.8, 1.2, -4.5 + cylIndex * 3.0 + (isRight ? -0.2 : 0.2));
          pGroup.rotation.z = -bankSign * (Math.PI / 4);

          // Piston Crown with Valve Reliefs
          const pistonCrown = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(boreRadius, boreRadius, 1.1, 24), materials.pistonAlloy);
          pistonCrown.position.y = 1.6;
          pGroup.add(pistonCrown);

          // Piston Ring Pack (3 Rings)
          const ringPack = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(boreRadius + 0.02, boreRadius + 0.02, 0.2, 24), materials.pistonRings);
          ringPack.position.y = 1.85;
          pGroup.add(ringPack);

          // Full-Floating 0.927" Wrist Pin
          const wristPin = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.24, 1.5, 16), materials.wristPin);
          wristPin.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
          wristPin.position.y = 1.5;
          pGroup.add(wristPin);

          // Forged 4340 H-Beam 5.700" Connecting Rod with Split Cap & ARP Bolts
          const rodGroup = new THREE.Group();
          const rodBeam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, rodLength, 0.22), materials.forgedRods);
          rodBeam.position.y = 0.3;
          rodGroup.add(rodBeam);

          // Twin ARP Rod Bolts
          [-0.3, 0.3].forEach((xOff) => {
            const rodBolt = createHexBoltMesh(0.08, 0.6, materials.fasteners);
            rodBolt.position.set(xOff, -rodLength / 2 + 0.3, 0);
            rodBolt.rotation.x = Math.PI;
            rodGroup.add(rodBolt);
          });
          pGroup.add(rodGroup);

          rotatingGroup.add(pGroup);
          pistonNodes.push({ group: pGroup, angleOffset: (p * Math.PI) / 4, baseY: 1.2 });
        }
        engineGroup.add(rotatingGroup);
        parts.rotating = rotatingGroup;

        // 5. CYLINDER HEADS WITH PHYSICAL 17-BOLT HEX PATTERN
        const headsGroup = new THREE.Group();
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          const headSub = new THREE.Group();
          headSub.position.set(side * 3.8, 3.2, 0);
          headSub.rotation.z = side * (-Math.PI / 4);

          const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.6, 2.6, 12.2), materials.headCasting);
          headSub.add(head);

          // 17 Hex Head Bolts per head!
          for (let b = 0; b < 17; b++) {
            const bX = (b % 2 === 0 ? -1.0 : 1.0);
            const bZ = -5.0 + (b / 2) * 1.3;
            const hBolt = createHexBoltMesh(0.16, 2.2, materials.fasteners);
            hBolt.position.set(bX, 1.3, bZ);
            headSub.add(hBolt);
          }

          const vc = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.8, 1.6, 11.6), materials.chrome);
          vc.position.y = 2.0;
          headSub.add(vc);

          headsGroup.add(headSub);
        });
        engineGroup.add(headsGroup);
        parts.heads = headsGroup;

        // Intake & Carburetor
        const intakeGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const intake = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4.2, 2.0, 9.6), materials.headCasting);
        intake.position.set(0, 3.4, 0);
        intakeGroup.add(intake);

        const carb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.6, 1.5, 2.8), materials.valveSprings);
        carb.position.set(0, 5.2, 0);
        intakeGroup.add(carb);

        const airFilter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3.6, 3.6, 1.4, 28), materials.chrome);
        airFilter.position.set(0, 6.5, 0);
        intakeGroup.add(airFilter);

        engineGroup.add(intakeGroup);
        parts.intake = intakeGroup;

        scene.add(engineGroup);
        renderer.render(scene, camera);

        // Animation Loop with Action Mode Kinematics
        let animId;
        let lastTime = performance.now();
        const animate = (now) => {
          animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
          lastTime = now;

          if (controls.update) controls.update();

          const f = explodedAmountRef.current;
          if (parts.heads) {
            parts.heads.children[0].position.set(-3.8 - f * 4.5, 3.2 + f * 4.5, 0);
            parts.heads.children[1].position.set(3.8 + f * 4.5, 3.2 + f * 4.5, 0);
          }
          if (parts.intake) parts.intake.position.y = 3.4 + f * 6.5;

          if (isRunningRef.current) {
            const radPerSec = (rpmRef.current / 60) * 2 * Math.PI;
            if (parts.crank) parts.crank.rotation.z += radPerSec * dt;
            if (parts.cam) parts.cam.children[0].rotation.z += (radPerSec * dt) / 2;

            pistonNodes.forEach((node) => {
              const theta = (parts.crank ? parts.crank.rotation.z : 0) + node.angleOffset;
              const disp = (crankRadius * Math.cos(theta)) + 
                           Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, Math.pow(rodLength, 2) - Math.pow(crankRadius * Math.sin(theta), 2))) - rodLength;
              node.group.position.y = node.baseY + disp * 0.45;
            });

            valvetrainNodes.forEach((v) => {
              const pulse = Math.max(0, Math.sin((parts.crank ? parts.crank.rotation.z : 0) * 0.5 + v.offset));
              v.lifter.position.y = v.baseY + pulse * 0.25;
              v.valve.position.y = 3.0 - pulse * 0.25;
              v.rocker.rotation.z = pulse * 0.15;
            });
          }

          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        };
        animate(performance.now());

        return () => {
          cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
          if (controls.dispose) controls.dispose();
          renderer.dispose();
        };
      }, [activeTab, viewMode, cutawayMode, currentEngineId, selectedIntakeId]);

      // --- TRANSMISSION 3D VIEWPORT INITIALIZATION ---
      useEffect(() => {
        if (activeTab !== 'trans') return;
        const container = transCanvasContainerRef.current;
        if (!container) return;

        const initialW = Math.max(container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth, 320);
        const initialH = Math.max(container.clientHeight || 480, 300);

        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x14181c);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(initialW, initialH);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
        container.innerHTML = '';
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        scene.add(new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2));
        scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.8));

        const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(24, 24, 0xe5a823, 0x334155);
        grid.position.y = -3.5;
        scene.add(grid);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, initialW / initialH, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(16, 10, 16);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

        const controls = setupUniversalOrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0));

        const transGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const alumMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x94a3b8, roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.7 });
        const goldMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe5a823, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.85 });
        const steelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x64748b, roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.9 });

        // Bellhousing
        const bellhousing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.8, 4.4, 3.2, 24, 1, true), alumMat);
        bellhousing.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
        bellhousing.position.x = -4.5;
        transGroup.add(bellhousing);

        // Torque Converter or Flywheel/Clutch
        const converter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3.6, 3.6, 1.6, 32), currentTrans.type === 'Automatic' ? goldMat : steelMat);
        converter.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
        converter.position.x = -4.5;
        transGroup.add(converter);

        // Case
        const mainCase = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(5.5, 3.8, 3.8), alumMat);
        transGroup.add(mainCase);

        // Tailhousing
        const tailshaft = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.6, 2.6, 4.2, 20), alumMat);
        tailshaft.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 2;
        tailshaft.position.x = 4.8;
        transGroup.add(tailshaft);

        scene.add(transGroup);
        renderer.render(scene, camera);

        let transAnimId;
        const animateTrans = () => {
          transAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(animateTrans);
          if (controls.update) controls.update();
          const f = transExplodedRef.current;
          bellhousing.position.x = -4.5 - f * 5.0;
          converter.position.x = -4.5 - f * 2.5;
          tailshaft.position.x = 4.8 + f * 5.0;
          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        };
        animateTrans();

        return () => {
          cancelAnimationFrame(transAnimId);
          if (controls.dispose) controls.dispose();
          renderer.dispose();
        };
      }, [activeTab, selectedTrans]);

      return (
        <div className="w-full min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-chevyDark text-gray-200">
          
          {/* TOP VEHICLE & ENGINE SELECTOR BAR */}
          <header ref={headerRef} className="flex-shrink-0 bg-chevyPanel border-b border-gray-700 px-3 py-2 flex flex-col gap-2 z-20 shadow-lg">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded bg-chevyOrange flex items-center justify-center font-black text-sm text-white shadow-md">
                  350
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h1 className="font-bold text-sm tracking-wide text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    {activeEngine.shortName} <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-chevyOrange/20 text-chevyOrange border border-chevyOrange/40 font-mono">TECHNICAL 3D ENGINE</span>
                  </h1>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">
                    Ray's Baseline: 5.700" Rods | 9.025" Deck | 64cc Heads | .039" Gasket | .015" Deck Clr | Quench .054"
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* NAV TABS */}
              <nav className="flex space-x-1 overflow-x-auto max-w-full">
                {[
                  { id: 'block3d', label: '1. Realistic 3D Cutaway', icon: '⚙️' },
                  { id: 'trans', label: '2. 3D Transmission (All 7 Units)', icon: '🏎️' },
                  { id: 'schematics', label: '3. 17-Bolt Specs & Schematics', icon: '📐' },
                  { id: 'shop', label: '4. Parts Counter & BOM', icon: '🏬' }
                ].map((tab) => (
                  <button
                    key={tab.id}
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                      activeTab === tab.id
                        ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white shadow'
                        : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>{tab.icon}</span>
                    <span>{tab.label}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </nav>
            </div>

            {/* SELECTION BAR */}
            <div className="bg-chevyDark/80 p-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-700/80 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="text-chevyGold text-[11px] font-bold">ENGINE CATALOG:</span>
                <select
                  value={currentEngineId}
                  onChange={(e) => setCurrentEngineId(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-chevyPanel border border-chevyOrange rounded px-2 py-1 text-white font-bold text-xs"
                >
                  {Object.values(ENGINE_DATABASE).map((eng) => (
                    <option key={eng.id} value={eng.id}>[{eng.era}] {eng.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-1 min-w-[220px]">
                <span className="text-cadCyan text-[11px] font-bold">INTAKE & CARB:</span>
                <select
                  value={selectedIntakeId}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedIntakeId(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-chevyPanel border border-cadCyan/60 rounded px-2 py-1 text-white text-xs flex-1 truncate font-mono"
                >
                  {activeEngine.intakes?.map((intk) => (
                    <option key={intk.id} value={intk.id}>{intk.name} ({intk.carbCfm} CFM)</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => setCurrentEngineId('sbc_350_ray')}
                className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-bold border border-chevyOrange bg-chevyOrange/20 text-chevyOrange hover:bg-chevyOrange hover:text-white"
              >
                Reset Ray's 350
              </button>
            </div>
          </header>

          {/* MAIN VIEWPORT */}
          <main className="flex-1 w-full relative">
            
            {/* TAB 1: 3D CUTAWAY ENGINE BLOCK WITH REALISTIC MACHINE-SHOP DETAIL */}
            {activeTab === 'block3d' && (
              <div 
                style={{
                  position: 'relative',
                  width: '100%',
                  height: `calc(100vh - ${headerHeight}px)`,
                  minHeight: '480px'
                }}
                className="overflow-hidden blueprint-grid"
              >
                <div ref={canvasContainerRef} style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', touchAction: 'none' }} className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing" />

                {/* CUTAWAY & REALISM BAR (TOP-LEFT) */}
                <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-10 flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-[calc(100%-24px)]">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 bg-chevyPanel/95 backdrop-blur border border-chevyOrange/60 p-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-xl text-xs font-mono">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-chevyGold uppercase px-1">🔪 CUTAWAY SLICE:</span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setCutawayMode('none')}
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium ${cutawayMode === 'none' ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                    >
                      Solid
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setCutawayMode('rightBank')}
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium ${cutawayMode === 'rightBank' ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                    >
                      Right Bank Cutaway
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setCutawayMode('centerLongitudinal')}
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium ${cutawayMode === 'centerLongitudinal' ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                    >
                      Crank Centerline Slice
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setCutawayMode('valvetrain')}
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium ${cutawayMode === 'valvetrain' ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                    >
                      Valvetrain & Lifters
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                    <div className="bg-chevyPanel/90 backdrop-blur border border-gray-700 p-1 rounded-lg flex space-x-1 shadow-xl">
                      <button onClick={() => setViewMode('realistic')} className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded ${viewMode === 'realistic' ? 'bg-chevyOrange text-white' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>Cast PBR</button>
                      <button onClick={() => setViewMode('ghost')} className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded ${viewMode === 'ghost' ? 'bg-cadCyan text-black font-bold' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>Ghost Glass</button>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => setIsRunning(!isRunning)}
                      className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg shadow-xl border flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                        isRunning ? 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-400 text-white animate-pulse' : 'bg-chevyPanel border-gray-700 text-gray-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span>{isRunning ? '⏹ STOP KINEMATICS' : '▶ RUN CYCLE ACTION'}</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Exploded View Slider */}
                <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4 sm:right-auto sm:w-96 z-10 bg-chevyPanel/95 backdrop-blur border border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-3 shadow-2xl space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-700 pb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-gray-300">EXPLODED DISASSEMBLY</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-chevyOrange font-bold">{Math.round(explodedAmount * 100)}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01"
                    value={explodedAmount}
                    onChange={(e) => setExplodedAmount(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-chevyOrange cursor-pointer h-2"
                  />
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1">
                    <span className="text-gray-400">Simulation RPM:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-chevyGold font-bold">{rpm} RPM</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range" min="600" max="6500" step="50"
                    value={rpm}
                    onChange={(e) => setRpm(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-chevyGold cursor-pointer h-2"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 2: 3D TRANSMISSION VIEWPORT (INCLUDES ALL 7 UNITS) */}
            {activeTab === 'trans' && (
              <div 
                style={{
                  position: 'relative',
                  width: '100%',
                  height: `calc(100vh - ${headerHeight}px)`,
                  minHeight: '480px'
                }}
                className="overflow-hidden blueprint-grid"
              >
                <div ref={transCanvasContainerRef} style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', touchAction: 'none' }} className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing" />

                <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-10 flex flex-wrap gap-2 max-w-[calc(100%-24px)]">
                  <div className="bg-chevyPanel/95 border border-chevyOrange p-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 shadow-xl">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-chevyGold font-mono uppercase">TRANSMISSION:</span>
                    <select
                      value={selectedTrans}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setSelectedTrans(e.target.value);
                        setStallSpeed(TRANSMISSIONS_DB[e.target.value].defaultStall || 2200);
                      }}
                      className="bg-chevyDark border border-gray-600 rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-white"
                    >
                      {Object.entries(TRANSMISSIONS_DB).map(([k, t]) => (
                        <option key={k} value={k}>[{t.type}] {t.name}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  {currentTrans.type === 'Automatic' && (
                    <div className="bg-chevyPanel/90 border border-gray-700 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="text-chevyGold font-bold">TORQUE CONVERTER STALL:</span>
                      <select
                        value={stallSpeed}
                        onChange={(e) => setStallSpeed(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                        className="bg-black/60 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-white font-mono"
                      >
                        <option value={1800}>1,800 RPM (Stock Cruiser)</option>
                        <option value={2200}>2,200 RPM (Mild Street / RV)</option>
                        <option value={2800}>2,800 RPM (Street Performance)</option>
                        <option value={3500}>3,500 RPM (Powerglide Drag)</option>
                        <option value={4500}>4,500 RPM (Competition Stall)</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4 sm:right-auto sm:w-96 z-10 bg-chevyPanel/95 backdrop-blur border border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-3 shadow-2xl space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-700 pb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-gray-300">BLOWN-APART TRANSMISSION</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-chevyGold font-bold">{Math.round(transExploded * 100)}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01"
                    value={transExploded}
                    onChange={(e) => setTransExploded(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-chevyGold cursor-pointer h-2"
                  />
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono mt-1">
                    Ratios: {currentTrans.ratios.join(', ')} | Clutch: {currentTrans.clutchPack}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 3: 17-BOLT SPECS & SCHEMATICS */}
            {activeTab === 'schematics' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Fasteners & 17-Bolt Cylinder Head Torquing Sequence</h2>
                <div className="p-4 bg-chevyPanel rounded-xl border border-gray-800 flex flex-col gap-3">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-chevyGold">17-Bolt Head Sequence (Stage 1: 25 ft-lbs ➔ Stage 2: 45 ft-lbs ➔ Stage 3: 65 ft-lbs)</span>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-chevyDark rounded-lg flex justify-between items-center max-w-lg mx-auto w-full">
                    {[13, 9, 5, 1, 3, 7, 11, 15, 17].map(n => (
                      <div key={n} className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-chevyOrange flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs text-white">{n}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-chevyDark rounded-lg flex justify-between items-center max-w-md mx-auto w-full">
                    {[14, 10, 6, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16].map(n => (
                      <div key={n} className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-chevyGold flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs text-white">{n}</div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto bg-chevyPanel rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
                    <thead className="bg-chevyDark text-gray-400">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="p-2.5">FASTENER</th>
                        <th className="p-2.5">THREAD</th>
                        <th className="p-2.5">FACTORY TORQUE</th>
                        <th className="p-2.5">PERFORMANCE / ARP</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-800">
                      {activeEngine.torqueSpecs.map((t, idx) => (
                        <tr key={idx}>
                          <td className="p-2.5 text-white font-bold">{t.item}</td>
                          <td className="p-2.5">{t.size}</td>
                          <td className="p-2.5 text-chevyOrange">{t.stock}</td>
                          <td className="p-2.5 text-emerald-400">{t.arp}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 4: PARTS COUNTER & BOM */}
            {activeTab === 'shop' && (
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Auto Parts Store & Mechanic Shop Counter Tool</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">SKU Cross-Reference, Job Estimator & Tolerances</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-mono bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 px-3 py-1.5 rounded">
                    QUENCH AUDIT: {activeEngine.quenchDistance}" (PASS)
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-chevyPanel border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white mb-2 font-mono">ITEMIZED BILL OF MATERIALS (BOM) & SKU LOOKUP</h3>
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
                    <thead className="bg-chevyDark text-gray-400">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="p-2">CATEGORY</th>
                        <th className="p-2">COMPONENT</th>
                        <th className="p-2">PART NUMBER</th>
                        <th className="p-2 text-right">PRICE</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-800">
                      <tr className="bg-cadCyan/5">
                        <td className="p-2 font-bold text-cadCyan">Induction System</td>
                        <td className="p-2">{activeIntake.name}</td>
                        <td className="p-2 text-chevyGold">{activeIntake.id}</td>
                        <td className="p-2 text-right font-bold text-emerald-400">${activeIntake.price.toFixed(2)}</td>
                      </tr>
                      {activeEngine.bom.map((b, i) => (
                        <tr key={i}>
                          <td className="p-2 font-bold text-white">{b.cat}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-gray-300">{b.part}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-chevyGold">{b.num}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-right font-bold text-emerald-400">${b.price.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

          </main>
        </div>
      );
    }

    ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<SBC350App />);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
